name: Muse Spark 1.3
short: Meta's frontier coding and long-horizon agentic model, 1M context / 131K output. Contributor/Free and Max are the same weights — only price and training-data consent differ.
modalities: Text, image, video, PDF in; text out
pricingNote: Free OpenCode Zen tier; Contributor $0.10/$0.20; Standard & Max effort $1.25/$4.25 per 1M
freeTierNote: Free OpenCode Zen tier (Contributor) in exchange for training-data consent — same weights as paid Standard; Max reasoning effort is Standard-tier only
standout: Elite all-round agentic coding and long-horizon agent work, with the same frontier weights reachable through a generous free/Contributor lane.
tradeoff: Tier identity, not capability, is the catch: Contributor/Free, Standard and Max share one set of weights, and only the price plus training-data consent differ — pick the lane by privacy, never by expected quality.
